description: This file defines the SavedModelBundle class in the TensorFlow Java API, which represents a loaded machine learning model including its computation graph and session. It provides methods for loading models, accessing the graph and session, and managing resources.

classes.name: SavedModelBundle
classes.description: Represents a loaded TensorFlow SavedModel, including its computation graph and session management.

classes.name: SavedModelBundle.Loader
classes.description: Inner class providing configuration options for loading a SavedModel, such as tags, configProto, and runOptions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to load a SavedModel from a directory with specified tags.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Static method that returns a Loader instance to configure and load a model.

methods.name: metaGraphDef
methods.description: Returns the serialized MetaGraphDef protocol buffer of the saved model.

methods.name: graph
methods.description: Returns the TensorFlow Graph associated with the loaded model.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Returns the TensorFlow Session associated with the loaded model.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the saved model, including the graph and session.
